newsitem.title: INDIA: TEXT - Indian president names Gujral prime minister.
newsitem.headline: TEXT - Indian president names Gujral prime minister.

text.p: Following is the text of a statement issued by Indian President Shankar Dayal Sharma on Sunday night announcing he had asked United Front leader Inder Kumar Gujral to serve as the next prime minister:

"The President, Dr Shankar Dayal Sharma, has been pleased to appoint Shri I.K. Gujral as Prime Minister and has asked him to advise the names of others to be appointed as members of the council of ministers.
The President has also requested Shri I.K. Gujral to seek a vote of confidence in the Lok Sabha by Tuesday, 22nd April, 1997.
The requisite oaths of office and secrecy are scheduled to be administered by the President on Monday, 21st April, 1997 at 1000 hours.

The President's decision to invite Shri I.K. Gujral to form a Government was taken in view of the Leader of the Congress Party in Parliament having declared that party's support to the formation of a government by a new leader of the United Front; the Bharatiya Janata Party's indication about its not being in a position to form a government; and, on balance of considerations relevant to the national interest, the advisability, at this juncture, of refraining from a mid-term poll so soon after the General Elections held in 1996, less than a year ago."
